Could you please share the following items so our legal/procurement teams can prepare an initial redline:

Alex / Marissa —

Quick contracting notes based on Aurelia's initial answers: 
- Entity & billing look straightforward — Priya is the right billing contact.
- Security ask: they mentioned HIPAA BAA 'if PHI later used' — we'll surface our standard BAA addendum (we already have a HIPAA addendum template).
- Key management: if they need CMK, that's an optional enterprise add-on (we support via KMS integrations). Ask infra for availability and potential latency considerations for us-east-1.

Redline strategy suggestion (internal):
- Start with Redwood standard MSA redline template. Accept standard Exhibit A (Service Description) and Exhibit B (SLA) as-is for negotiation speed.
- Push back on uncapped indemnity and limit to 3x annual fees or $1M floor (whichever is higher).
- Narrow confidentiality carve-outs for aggregated analytics only; keep customer data protections intact.
- For billing: prefer invoice net-30; if they require PO/Net-45, Jonas to handle reconciliation and approvals.

Proposed timeline: party sheet returned within 48 hours, Redwood sends marked-up MSA + Order Form within 7 business days, then schedule a 30-minute legal sync if significant redlines.

I'll draft the internal redline notes and assign Jonas to billing items.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
